findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: The employees could not produce any manager certifications at the time of the inspection. Ensure that there is at least one employee who is a Certified Food Protection Manager during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The vent covers above the flat top grill were heavily accumulated with grease buildup. Grease droplets were starting to form. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that vent covers are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent buildup and contamination of food items.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
A self closure is needed on the outside door to keep out pests and rodents.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure this is present on the door by your next inspection.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Chopped green peppers were observed in the refrigerator with a date mark of 6/15, 17 days prior to inspection date.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure opened or cut foods are not held more than the 7 day maximum allowance.

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Exterior door should be self-closing. Provide a self-closer that can hold the door closed.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Items needing to be addressed from the pre-opening:
Caulk counters to wall
Seal holes in wall beneath hood
THE CEILING is not smooth and easily cleanable and has slight water damage at hood vent over grill. Kilz and replace so surface is smooth and easily cleanable.

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.
